text:
WEEKLY ADS RECOMMENDATION (pending your approval)

Action: Pause the four duplicated legacy-structure ad groups inside Geo Twin campaign 24164623336: ContractMfg-Haircare (200926047593), ContractMfg-Skincare (200926047833), ContractMfg-Cosmetic-Beauty (200926047753), ProductIntent-BeardOil (200926047793).

Why: These are copies of the source campaign structure that rode along when the twin was created. They compete in the same auctions as the purpose-built AG1-AG4 groups and are winning, because their broader keywords match far more queries. The result is that 79% of twin budget flows through a group whose landing page and copy were never tuned for the geo twin, while the four groups built for it, each with a matched collection landing page, are starved.

Expected: Twin impressions should fall sharply and CTR should rise toward the 2.0-2.4% range AG3 and AG4 already show. Skincare regains real presence. Clicks will drop and CPC will rise from $0.17 toward $0.30-0.50; that is the intended trade, buying fewer and more relevant clicks. Landing-page match improves, which should raise gclid-bearing form starts.

Measure: 14 days, 2026-09-13 through 2026-09-26, comparing twin CTR, click distribution across AG1-AG4, and gclid-bearing lead count.

Risk: If the starved groups cannot fill the volume, twin traffic could drop more than expected. Fully reversible by re-enabling the four ad groups.

Evidence. Best: Geo Twin campaign 24164623336 — $36.78 for 219 clicks at $0.17 CPC vs main ContractMfg $125.81 for 130 clicks at $0.97. 68% more clicks on 29% of the spend. Worst: Ad group ContractMfg-Haircare (200926047593) inside Geo Twin — 13,584 impressions, 177 clicks, 1.30% CTR, $29.23 = 79% of twin spend. Grew from 655 impressions and $4.83 the prior week.

Waste signal: Twin impressions rose 5,922 to 15,614 (+164%) while CTR fell 1.87% to 1.40% and CPC fell $0.33 to $0.17. Cheaper, higher-volume, less relevant inventory. Concentrated almost entirely in one duplicate ad group. Starved: AG1 Skincare 5 impressions, AG2 Haircare 5, ContractMfg-Skincare 1 in twin. Skincare, one of the two named priority verticals, has effectively no paid presence. Note: INFERRED, not from a search-terms report. The reporting tool exposes only ad_group, ad_group_ad, campaign and customer resources, so search_term_view is unavailable and no term-level waste list could be pulled this cycle.

Consultant oversight: Sound and reversible, and I back it. Two things Sam must see with it. First, the Samples campaign and Sales Campaign PLL both show as PAUSED this week; no approval for that is on record, so who paused them needs answering. Second, gclid capture is failing at 0 of 20 and the site's primary quote buttons are still dead, so better ad-group targeting still lands traffic on a broken route. Fix the route or the gain is unmeasurable.
spoken_text: Sam, the Ads Agent wants to pause four duplicate ad groups inside the geo twin campaign, and it needs your yes before anything moves. Those four are copies that rode along when the twin was built, and one of them is eating seventy nine percent of the twin budget while the skincare group we built for it got five impressions all week. Traffic went up a lot but click through fell, so we are buying cheaper and less relevant clicks. Pausing them means fewer clicks at a higher price, which is the trade we want, and it is fully reversible. Two things bother me. Samples and the old sales campaign are both paused and nobody recorded approving that. And we still capture no click IDs and the quote buttons on the site are dead, so even a better targeted click lands on a broken route.
